faqs.question: How do I place an order?
faqs.answer: Ordering happens on WhatsApp or on our Telegram channel! Tap 'WhatsApp' on any perfume to chat directly with us at 09055334786, or join our Telegram channel (@ayomsscentss) to view current prices, check availability, and place your order. We confirm stock immediately, share payment details, and deliver promptly.

faqs.question: How do you guarantee your perfumes are 100% original?
faqs.answer: All our fragrances are authentic and imported from certified brand distributors across France, the UK, and the US. Every perfume bottle has a traceable batch code that you can verify directly.

faqs.question: How does delivery work in Covenant University (CU)?
faqs.answer: We provide fast, convenient delivery directly to your hall of residence, room, or anywhere on the Covenant University (CU) campus. Once you place an order on WhatsApp or Telegram, we coordinate directly with you for prompt hand-off.

faqs.question: How are the perfumes protected during delivery?
faqs.answer: All perfumes are carefully cushioned and packaged in protective materials to prevent damage and keep the fragrance oils safe and intact.

faqs.question: Can I get mini perfume samples (decants) before buying a full bottle?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer 5ml and 10ml travel sample sizes for select perfumes. Chat with us on WhatsApp or Telegram to order your discovery samples.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept instant bank transfers. Once confirmed, your receipt and delivery details are provided right away.
